calendar.title: Provider upgrade review with platform team
calendar.description: Review the Q3 provider upgrade rollout plan and sign off on the migration window.

emails.title: Provider upgrade rollout plan — please review before Thursday
emails.body: Hi Joel, attached is the rollout plan for the provider upgrade we discussed. It touches every module your team owns, so I'd like your sign-off before the 9am review Thursday. The migration window is proposed for the night of August 27th. Let me know if that conflicts with anything.
emails.author: priya@platform.mercury.dev

emails.title: [mercury/backend] 3 new pull requests opened
emails.body: Three pull requests were opened overnight in mercury/backend: #412 fix flaky ingestion test, #413 add retry backoff to embedding client, #414 bump lxml to 5.3.1.

emails.title: Water maintenance notice for Glicínias district, August 22
emails.body: The municipal water utility will perform scheduled maintenance in the Glicínias district on August 22 between 09:00 and 13:00. Some interruption to water pressure is expected.
emails.author: newsletter@cm-aveiro.pt

emails.title: Re: 1:1 agenda — quick topics for today

emails.title: The Bundling of Everything
emails.body: This week's essay looks at how AI assistants are becoming the new aggregation point for services that used to be separately bundled, and what that means for platform owners.
emails.author: ben@stratechery.com
